architecture.title: The guest-request copilot — code for facts, Jev for judgments, code for policy, people for actions
architecture.caption: Language and room number are computed exactly in code; ONE batched Jev call answers five independent questions; a readable policy applies the safety override and the uncertainty gate; the output is a ticket proposal with a templated reply draft and execute: False.

charts.caption: Measured by labs/lab02_shadow_mode.py (jev-1.13.0, 2026-09-27). The same author wrote the messages and the keyword list — a stacked deck that shows failure KINDS, not accuracy. Promotion needs a large held-out set of real traffic.
